bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $252 支撑

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 9.2% on Oct 14 to $239.34 and is down 18% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($263.7), 10-day ($275.9), 30-day ($269.6) and 100-day ($253.3, edging lower) averages and above the 200-day ($214.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($296.1), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月14日下跌 9.2%，收于 $239.34，五个交易日下跌 18%。股价位于 5 日（$263.7）、10 日（$275.9）、30 日（$269.6）和 100 日均线（$253.3，小幅下行）下方，并在 200 日均线（$214.9）上方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$296.1），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The $252 support (Sep 24 low and 100-day average) and the Oct 13 low ($248) both broke on the close, ending the range; the day's low was $235.7. That $248–253 zone is now first resistance, then $264 (5-day) and $270 (30-day). Support is $230 (June pivot), then $215 (200-day average) and $197.5 (Sep 1 low). A close below $230 would open $215.
read.zh: $252 支撑（9月24日低点及 100 日均线）和 10月13日低点（$248）均在收盘时失守，区间格局结束；当日低点 $235.7。$248–253 区域现为第一阻力，其次 $264（5 日均线）和 $270（30 日均线）。支撑为 $230（6月转折点），其次 $215（200 日均线）和 $197.5（9月1日低点）。若收盘跌破 $230，下一目标看 $215。

r.en: Old $252 support, Oct 13 low and 100-day average ($248–253)
